messages:
anya: Heads up — trying to onboard an HF model that requires trust_remote_code. conversion script dies at auto_map step, tokenizer special tokens are showing up as byte-escaped sequences in the chat templates. anyone seen this?

michael: can you paste the failing traceback and the model repo URL?

anya: repo: https://huggingface.co/extern/phi-astral-v1 (private mirror). traceback snippet: 
```
ValueError: Unexpected token bytes in <special_tokens_map>: b'\xc2\xa0'
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
AssertionError: autoload class mapping failed for 'PhiModelConfig' in auto_map
```

anya: also the model's config.json has a custom "architectures" entry and a weird `chat_templates` field that uses <|user|> vs <|human|> placeholders.

sasha: ugh, yep. trust_remote_code lets HF load custom classes, but our converter's auto_map searches expected class names and bails if constructor signature mismatches. often the workaround is to provide a manual mapping in the padmap for the model.

jamal: quick test — can you try running the conversion with the experimental flag I added? `./tools/hf2rw --repo phi-astral-v1 --allow-remote --manual-class "PhiModelConfig:redwood.adapters.PhiConfigShim"`

anya: tried that, it gets past auto_map but tokenizer pads still broken in outputs. chat template rendering inserts "\u00a0" for nonbreaking spaces which our chatfmt layer treats as tokens, so generation drifts.

michael: likely two separate issues: 1) config class mapping/constructor mismatch 2) tokenizer special token encoding. for (2) try normalizing tokenizer special tokens after conversion:
```python
from redwood.token import load_tokenizer
tok = load_tokenizer('converted/phi-astral')
# replace nonbreaking space sequences with regular space in special tokens
for k,v in tok.special_tokens_map.items():
    tok.special_tokens_map[k] = {k2: v2.replace('\u00a0', ' ') for k2,v2 in v.items()}
tok.save_pretrained('converted/phi-astral/cleaned')
```

sasha: for the class mapping mismatch, we should add a shim that wraps the HF custom config and exposes the args our runtime expects. I can sketch a shim and submit a small PR to the conversion tool.

anya: thanks. note: after forcing conversions and running quantization (int8 on our quant runner) we saw a BLEU/QA accuracy dip ~6% relative to float16 baseline on our eval set — might be from tokenizer change or attention-kernel differences.

jamal: can you attach the eval diffs? also which quant backend? ngquant or tq8?

anya: tq8. diff: top failures are answer truncation and hallucination on long prompts. logs: 
```
[eval] model=phi-astral quant=tq8 metric=qa_exact_match baseline_fp16=0.72 quant=0.68 delta=-0.04
[eval] model=phi-astral quant=tq8 metric=bleu baseline_fp16=0.41 quant=0.38 delta=-0.03
```

michael: seems modest but real. if tokenizer produced extra tokens (NBSP) that could explain truncation. before blaming quant, isolate by running FP16 with the converted tokenizer and the runtime.

anya: good call — running FP16 with cleaned tokenizer now. ETA 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy job #4482 queued for workspace 'eng-ml' (tools/hf2rw conversion). status: queued -> running

sasha: I'll own the shim for config class and add better auto_map heuristics (constructor arg matching). jamal — can you re-run tq8 quant with the cleaned tokenizer once anya posts results?

jamal: yep, will run after anya's FP16 sanity check.

anya: FP16 run with cleaned tokenizer finished: QA EM back to 0.71 (baseline 0.72), BLEU 0.40. so most regression went away. tq8 still a little lower but not catastrophic.

michael: great — action items: sasha PR shim + unit test for custom architectures; add a post-conversion tokenizer-normalize step to hf2rw; jamal to re-run quant bench and update quant recommendations doc if tq8 consistently drops >3%.

anya: filed follow-ups: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-7392 (shim + auto_map), https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-7393 (tokenizer-normalize pipeline), INF-7394 (quant bench rerun). assigning sasha/jamal.

sasha: I'll land a minimal shim today and include a sample mapping yaml option for HF repos that need manual class wiring.

michael: thanks team. good reminder to add a small checklist for HF bring-ups: check chat_template placeholders, special token encodings, auto_map preview, run FP16 sanity before quant.

anya: agreed — added to INF-7392 checklist. :thumbsup:
